description: Implement trunk-based development flow with automated promotion gate: code merged to main → auto-deploy to staging → run integration tests → promote to prod if all checks pass. Must: configure branch protection on main (require PR, require CI, require review), set up auto-deploy to staging on merge, run integration + smoke tests on staging, configure promotion gate requiring green tests + manual approval for prod, and verify rollback path if prod deployment fails. Risk factors: broken main blocking all developers, promotion gate too loose (bad code reaches prod), staging-prod drift causing false negatives. Tools available: GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, kubectl, Helm, Slack.
